parameters.query:
with params as (
  select $1::uuid as primary_run, $2::uuid as compare_run
),
guard as (
  -- Refuse to score across different L2 inputs. Finding ids would not overlap
  -- by construction, so every insight would read as 'did not reproduce'.
  select p.primary_run, p.compare_run
  from params p
  where p.primary_run <> p.compare_run
    and (select source_run_id from project_insight where run_id = p.primary_run limit 1) is not null
    and (select source_run_id from project_insight where run_id = p.primary_run limit 1)
      = (select source_run_id from project_insight where run_id = p.compare_run limit 1)
),
pf as (
  select pi.run_id, pi.id, array_agg(pif.finding_id order by pif.finding_id) as fset
  from project_insight pi
  join project_insight_finding pif on pif.project_insight_id = pi.id
  where pi.run_id in (select primary_run from guard union all select compare_run from guard)
  group by pi.run_id, pi.id
),
scored as (
  select a.id,
         max(cardinality(array(select unnest(a.fset) intersect select unnest(b.fset)))::numeric
             / nullif(cardinality(array(select unnest(a.fset) union select unnest(b.fset))), 0)) as s
  from pf a
  join guard g on a.run_id = g.primary_run
  join pf b on b.run_id = g.compare_run
  group by a.id
),
upd as (
  update project_insight p
  set stability_score = round(scored.s, 3),
      stability_compared_run_id = (select compare_run from guard)
  from scored
  where p.id = scored.id
  returning p.id, scored.s as s
)
select
  (select count(*) from guard) as guard_ok,
  (select count(*) from upd) as insights_scored,
  (select round(avg(s), 3) from upd) as mean_stability,
  (select count(*) from upd where s >= 0.7) as reproduced,
  (select count(*) from upd where s >= 0.4 and s < 0.7) as partial,
  (select count(*) from upd where s < 0.4) as did_not_reproduce

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: Number($json.guard_ok) === 1, guard_ok: Number($json.guard_ok) === 1, primary_run_id: $('Normalize Input').first().json.primary_run_id, compare_run_id: $('Normalize Input').first().json.compare_run_id, insights_scored: Number($json.insights_scored), mean_stability: Number($json.mean_stability), reproduced: Number($json.reproduced), partial: Number($json.partial), did_not_reproduce: Number($json.did_not_reproduce), note: Number($json.guard_ok) === 1 ? null : "Refused: the two runs do not share a source_run_id, so their findings cannot overlap." } }}
